title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence, spectral positivity, and parity dichotomies across analytic number theory, spectral geometry, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.9.0 adds Waves 16 and 17 (8,563 new lines across 4 strictly additive modules under PakStokes/AllD/, pushing PakStokesAllD to 50,702 lines across 26 modules, with 288 new public declarations / 198 new public theorems), proved 100% unconditionally from Mathlib with zero placeholders or custom foundations: (1) Wave 16 — Unique-Sum Isolation Trees, Stokes Jet-Rank Ideal Linearization, and Single-Singularity Arbitrary-Order-d Family (UniqueSumAndJetIdealCore.lean, 2,137 lines, 72 public decls / 52 theorems, Paper #12): sequential compactness unique-sum extension and cofinite-branching trees with no lower-degree collisions and exact D! permutation multiplicity (HasUniqueRep, uniqueSum_extension_cofinite, uniqueSum_tree_exists, uniqueSum_no_lower_collision, uniqueSum_perm_collisions), symmetric multilinear polarization vanishing and Vandermonde tail-span obstruction (homogPolarize, vandermonde_tail_span_complex, reciprocal_accumulation_polarization_obstruction — taking unique-sum Fourier/polarization vanishing as hypothesis supplied analytically by Paper #12), Stokes jet-rank ideal linearization characterizing the full polynomial relation ideal via affine linear equations of ker Delta and exact transcendence degree r (StokesJetSystem, stokes_jet_ideal_linearization, stokes_jet_ideal_linearization_field), and the single-singularity arbitrary-order-d family with invertible Vandermonde jet matrix and explicit order-d annihilator (singleSingJetMatrixCast_rank, singleSingOrderDOp_annihilates_nonneg, single_singularity_order_d_rank); (2) Wave 16 — Depth-3 S_3 Eulerian Idempotents, Cubic Slice-Rank Closedness, and Tao's Diagonal Lower Bound (DepthThreeSliceRankCore.lean, 2,106 lines, 89 public decls / 58 theorems): exact 3-sector Eulerian projectors e1 + e2 + e3 = id on 3-tensors and Q[S_3] with regular dimension decomposition 6 = 2 + 3 + 1 (eulerian_sum_eq_id, lieInvariant, mixedBilinear, eulerianReg_dim_decomposition_rat), free depth-3 shuffle algebra identities and e2-period pairing (depth3_shuffle_identity, depth3_alternating_shuffle_identity, depth3_e2_period_pairing), exact equivalence between cubic slice rank <= N and vanishing on a codimension <= N subspace (cubic_sliceRank_le_iff_vanishes_on_codim_subspace, symTensor_cubic_sliceRank_le_iff_vanishes_on_codim_subspace), and Tao's exact diagonal cubic slice-rank lower bound and jet-weighted V_cube obstruction (tao_diagonal_cubic_sliceRank_exact, diag_cubic_symSliceRank_lower_bound, vCube_jet_poly_symSliceRank_lower_bound); (3) Wave 17 — Berndt Notebooks V Entry 45 Stieltjes Indeterminacy, > 1.7x Gross CM Hecke Radius Separation, Abstract Multivariate Radius Peeling, and Ramanujan LN p. 343 Hidden Units (HeckeRadiusPeelingAndBerndtEntry45.lean, 2,092 lines, 72 public decls / 50 theorems): 100% unconditional resolution of Bruce Berndt's open remark on Ramanujan's Notebooks V Ch. 32 Entry 45 via explicit positive oscillatory densities with identical Stieltjes moments (entry45Perturb_abs_lt_weight, entry45Perturb_moment_zero, entry45_stieltjes_indeterminate), 100% unconditional Lambert-series E_4 bounds and > 1.7x consecutive Gross CM Hecke radius separation rho_163 < rho_67 < rho_43 < rho_19 < rho_11 (eisensteinE4_norm_bounds, grossRadius_consecutive_ratio_gt, grossRadius_strictMono, grossRadius_chain), 100% unconditional verification of Ramanujan's Lost Notebook p. 343 hidden units in Z[2^(1/5)]^x and Z[2^(1/7)]^x (ln343_real_identity, ln343_unit_in_Z_adjoin_fifthRoot2, ln343_block2_seventhRoot2_units), plus abstract multivariate natural-boundary radius peeling over an independent base family taking local boundary non-continuation as input (exists_minimal_relation_nonzero_separant, radius_peeling_joint_diff_indep, radius_peeling_over_baseField, grossCM_ten_series_radius_peeling, universal_pair_radius_peeling); and (4) Wave 17 — Exponent-Measure Polynomial-Weight Rank Core and Komatsu Poly-Cauchy Exact Algebraic Core (ExponentMeasureAndPolyCauchyCore.lean, 2,228 lines, 55 public decls / 38 theorems, Paper #12 Section 7 and Corollary 7.3): infinite-support polynomial-weight linear independence in L^1(mu) and ComplexMeasure R (poly_ae_zero_imp_zero_of_infinite_support, poly_weight_rank_infinite_support, poly_weight_rank_complexMeasure_infinite_support, poly_weight_rank_finite_support_le), exponent-atom Laurent operator T = x d/dx - 1/x, finite-support annihilator, and shift-band measure pushforward (laurentT_add_smul_expAtom, finite_support_measure_annihilated, shift_band_measure_identity), exact Lebesgue log-density moments (polyCauchy_log_density_moment), classical Cauchy differential relation C_1 = (1 + x) C_2 + x^2 C_2' (cauchy_first_second_kind_relation), two-endpoint analytic peeling proving exact poly-Cauchy jet-span dimension losing precisely 1 dimension iff both k = 1 kinds are present (polyCauchy_densities_poly_indep_of_not_both_one, polyCauchy_densities_both_one_relation, polyCauchy_jet_span_finrank), and nonpositive-index Euler-polynomial D-finite collapse (polyCauchy_nonpos_dfinite_poly). All 863 audited declarations in Verify.lean (665 Waves 1-15 + 100% of all 198 public theorems across Waves 16-17) depend strictly on standard Lean axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or subsets thereof) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
